corrections.statement: Source-only correction after the CLAUDE-011 review (FIX_BEFORE_AUDITOR_FIXTURES). Heuristic JSON discovery was replaced by exact parsing of run_manifest.json, estimates_22.json and decision.json at the paths, keys, types, labels and precision-60 Decimal encoding of PRODUCER_OUTPUT_INTERFACE_CONTRACT.json; all C++ and Python mismatch diagnostics were redacted to category, coordinates or record index, and field name; C++ usage errors now exit 2 without a receipt; the fixture gate now uses the exact analysis schemas, checks each INVALID diagnostic and writes a FAIL receipt on unexpected exceptions. Replay algorithms, scientific constants, record layouts, fixed counts, namespace isolation and component independence are unchanged.

corrections.statement: Source-only completion of the bounded auditor interface correction against PRODUCER_OUTPUT_INTERFACE_CONTRACT_R2.json (revision 2, supersedes revision 1). The Python verifier now enforces the six exact interpretation labels in order, the exact 24-key run_manifest.json root, exact integer range lengths 1,2,2,2,2,4, records 1-4 family_decision equal to the recomputed primary decision, records 5-6 classification and relation_to_allele_enrichment_descriptive equal to their recomputed values and cannot_alter_primary_decision true, and '%d/%d' exact fractions including denominator 1; it reproduces the revision-2 Decimal order (precision-60 dec(Fraction), then the precision-60 half-width via inner, then precision-60 lower/upper). A NONSCIENTIFIC manifest-interface mode checks only manifest schema, entry uniqueness, byte counts and hashes over placeholder files of at most 4096 bytes and never parses a record, simulates or derives a key; production mode is unchanged. The fixture gate adds a 97-file manifest-interface control (PASS) and a single outputs[37].sha256 corruption (INVALID) with diagnostic and receipt redaction checks. C++ sources, replay algorithms, scientific constants, binary layouts, fixed counts, namespace rules and component independence are unchanged.
